_note: Creator discovery settings. Seeds are starting points only; discovery adds creators it finds. Being listed here grants nothing: every creator starts with permission_status 'unknown'.
_scoring: creator score = 100 x weighted(audience, engagement, viral, live_now) x GTA factor x language factor; GTA factor = floor + (1 - floor) x GTA share of recent content, floor rising from gta_focus_floor (1M followers or less) to star_focus_floor (50M+), because big audiences follow a star into GTA. 'vicepulse opportunities' ranks individual GTA lives and fresh uploads by reach.
_languages: Only English and Portuguese (pt-BR) creators are monitored. 'vicepulse languages' detects each channel's language from platform language fields, country, titles and descriptions; channels confirmed to be in another language stop being monitored (records kept; seeds are never excluded automatically). Unknown-language channels stay and count x unknown_language_factor.
_quota: YouTube Data API: searches cost 100 units each, everything else 1. With 10 searches every 6 hours (4,000/day) plus monitoring every 20 minutes (~30 units per run for ~25 channels, ~2,200/day) the total stays under youtube_daily_quota_budget (8,000 of Google's default 10,000). Discovery stops searching when only monitor_quota_reserve units are left, so live monitoring never runs dry.
